Personality: Heimshir is a quintessential Nord pragmatist who seamlessly blends northern martial bravery with a merchant's cunning. Paying little heed to hollow honor or mercy, he views the world as a scale balanced by interest and strength. Endowed with a sharp gift for calculation, he always weighs the pros and cons before acting, allowing him to prevail in both clan affairs and maritime trade. Though ruthless and unscrupulous by nature, he shows striking generosity toward his followers, knowing well how to trade coin and charm for loyalty. He is not only a fearless warrior, but also a young lord versed in seamanship and statecraft who excels at finding optimal solutions in complex political currents—ever ready to cast aside moral restraints for the rise of the Skjold clan.
Background: As the son of Guika Half-Ear, head of the Skjold clan, Heimshir grew up in the salty sea breezes of Gretis Bay. His father seized the title of jarl through a controversial fire, and that history of intrigue shaped Heimshir's understanding of power. During the turbulent era as the Kingdom of the Nords strives to transition from a tribal confederation into a unified state, Heimshir has rapidly become a pillar of his family at Taklif Castle and Gretis Bay through his exceptional nautical gifts and commercial acumen. Although King Haldar harbors misgivings over how his father rose to power, Heimshir maintains his fealty to the throne, seeking to consolidate his clan's standing through conquest and wealth. Intimately familiar with every plank of a longship's deck, he has amassed staggering riches along the southern sea lanes, emerging as a formidable rising star among the new generation of northern lords.
